custom_commands: u=$(getent passwd 1000 | cut -d: -f1) && echo "$u ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/90-ikigai-install && chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/90-ikigai-install; runuser -l "$u" -c 'curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MSILycanthropy/ikigai/main/boot.sh | bash'; rc=$?; rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/90-ikigai-install; exit $rc
